notes: Mobile Harness Code — independent fork of Mobile Harness. New: background-lifecycle hardening. The microphone is released as soon as the app is stopped (screen off, switching apps, recents), so no audio is captured in the background and no SpeechRecognizer survives a background → foreground cycle — a deliberate listen still works in split-screen / PiP. SSH tunnels now report "running" only while the accept loop, the loopback socket AND the live SSH transport are all healthy, so a tunnel whose SSH link died in the background (Doze / network drop) shows as stopped instead of a stale "running"; combined with the foreground-resume status refresh and the clean teardown of tunnels + PTY shell when the screen closes (no leaked listeners, PTY channels or transports). Fail-closed throughout: the app never auto-reconnects or re-sends credentials — it only refreshes status. Existing tools untouched: providers + AI router/fallback, local model (Ollama), MCP client, RAG, workspace tools, safe Skill system, SSH client/tunnel/TOFU/PTY terminal + keyboard, Phone Control (Shizuku/Wireless ADB/root), in-app update, Telegram bot, multimodal Sidekick, Eco Mode, Share & Invite. This APK is SIGNED (V1+V2+V3); install mobile-harness-online.apk.
